# Termux-Diffusion Full Technical Specification (v1.8.1)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Official Z-Image Turbo (6.0B DiT) & Pure Native On-Device Diffusion Acceleration for Android Termux
Executes 6.0B DiT (Z-Image Turbo) and quantized Stable Diffusion models with Tri-Engine asymmetric offloading, layer streaming, Vulkan compute shaders, and ARMv8.2-A DotProd/FP16 NEON SIMD.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-diffusion
- Command: pip install termux-diffusion && termux-diffusion install
# or:
npm install termux-diffusion && npx termux-diffusion install
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-diffusion
